title: ToolResult
description: What every oneapi-agent tool returns, over MCP and on the CLI (stdout). CLI exit code: 0 = ok, 1 = fail, 2 = anything else.

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result (e.g. compile, verify).

status.description: ok: the checked property holds. fail: the tool ran and it does not hold. error: the tool could not do its job. toolchain_missing: a required binary was not found (evidence names it). timeout: an external command timed out.

summary.description: One line for humans; never a substitute for evidence.

evidence.description: Tool-specific facts: commands that ran, exit codes, parsed diagnostics, numbers. Keys differ per tool.

limitations.description: What this result does NOT prove. Carry these into any report.
